messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — noticed ~12% p99 regression on canary after flipping kernel selector to prefer 'slabbed-flash' for long sequences. Repro on the chatbenchmark harness.
kevin: ugh. which model + batch configs? stack traces?
maya: model=gpt-large-ish, seq=2048, batch=4. perf snippet:
```
gen_total: 112ms p50 / 502ms p99
kernel_flash_slab: 18ms p50 / 210ms p99
kernel_paged_fused: 22ms p50 / 98ms p99
kv_serialization: 4ms
memcopy_stride_miss: spikes ~120us
```
ashwin: that kernel p99 for slab looks like bank conflict or unaligned loads. did we change dtype/packing flags in the selector? kevin merged a change last night I think.
omar: FYI the canary also flipped kv layout to 'slabbed-interleave' — that reorders banks every 64 bytes. If dtype==bf16 and alignment != 64 we get misaligned SIMD loads.
scheduler-bot: canary-deploy: service=redwood-inference-runtime env=canary user=kevin status=deployed 2149876550
perfbot: perf-diff ready at https://perf.internal/compare/2149876543 (baseline vs canary)
linda: quick triage plan: (1) re-run microbench with same seq/batch and toggles: --kernel=slabbed-flash|paged-fused, --kv_layout=interleave|separate, --pack=bfloat16|fp16, --align=64|128. (2) collect nvprof metrics: gld_efficiency, l2_hit_rate, achieved_occupancy. (3) run greedy-batcher off vs on.
maya: I'll run step 1 & 2 on a dedicated canary node now. starting with pack=bf16 align=64 then flip align→128.
kevin: also capture a flamegraph for the kernel — add --trace-kernel=flash_slab to the harness.
nashwin: if we confirm bank-folding, quick mitigation is to fall back to paged-fused for seq>1024 or when memcopy_stride_miss > threshold. PR suggestion incoming.
omar: small note: there's a known allocator padding bug that can shift kv pointers by 24 bytes — check the allocator_trace for the run.
maya: got first run results: slabbed p99 still high when align=64 + bf16. align=128 brought kernel_p99 down from 210ms → 92ms. summarized: 
```
config: slabbed-interleave / bf16 / align=64 -> kernel_p99=210ms, gen_p99=502ms
config: slabbed-interleave / bf16 / align=128 -> kernel_p99=92ms, gen_p99=320ms
config: paged-fused / bf16 / align=64 -> kernel_p99=98ms, gen_p99=340ms
memcopy_stride_miss count: align64=18 spikes/run, align128=2 spikes/run
```
linda: great signal. sounds like alignment+dtype interacting with interleaved banks. Let's schedule an action: kevin to revert kernel-selector pref for canary; ashwin to add an alignment check in runtime; maya to produce repro harness and numbers by EOD.
kevin: will revert canary now. thanks all :thumbsup:
nashwin: filing follow-ups: GH#4321 (alignment guard), GH#4322 (selector fallback). I'll link perf artifacts when maya posts them.
maya: thanks — posting the harness link and perf artifact shortly.
